routes.preconditions: owner 인증; 기존 source/asset owner 일치; raw_text 또는 권리 확인된 유효 asset
routes.request_and_effect: application/json if no new files; multipart/form-data: manifest JSON SourceInput + exact new_assets.part_name parts; reject duplicate/missing/extra; bytes media verify; rights false or unsafe asset reject 422, keep existing immutable sources
routes.response: 201 new immutable snapshot; H1 no external mutation; client may explicitly retry if response lost; duplicate source alone no external effect

routes.request_and_effect: ListQuery cursor/limit; default limit 20; opaque owner-bound cursor, order created_at DESC then source_id DESC; invalid cursor 400
routes.response: 200 persisted summaries; omit next_cursor when end

routes.request_and_effect: id path opaque source_id; no body
server resolves supported registry; unsupported/blocked persist normal view, no external navigation; supported prepares; model unavailable => persisted ready=false issue; no raw credentials
routes.response: 201 RegistrationView, job_state=null, no start; synchronous bounded

routes.preconditions: owner; job_state=null; revision current; auth human/verifying must close first
routes.request_and_effect: at least one source_id/selector/answers/corrections. Source/selector changed -> no simultaneous old answers/corrections; clear incompatible facts/answers and binding, regenerate. Same source_id may explicitly reprepare after transient model failure. Current issue_id->field; corrections reference valid profile field JSON Pointer; normalize server ResolvedAnswer; no direct values/status patch; duplicate/conflicting paths rejected. Shared fact correction needs new Source. Material change invalidates review/binding. Recalculate ready; source/profile unchanged retain compatible answers.
routes.response: 200 current RegistrationView, revision increment on persisted mutation; no browser mutation

routes.preconditions: owner; job_state=null; supported+ready for open; expected_revision current; generation required for finish/close/refresh
routes.request_and_effect: open from none/closed; return human grant. finish only human current generation: fence human then verify account, target, connection; verified even target existing/ambiguous but no review. close prestart only, fence and invalidate binding/review; refresh human only current generation; rotate grant, prior grant invalid; timeout closes/fences, no verified binding. Do not expose internal ref or credentials. Viewer disconnect not close command.
routes.response: 200 AuthResponse; grant only open/refresh; state/target on returned registration; 409 stale/phase, 503 runtime timeout/error with safe state reread

routes.preconditions: owner; id owned; exact current revision/review digest, ready, verified/new, supported, scope/permission/connection current
routes.request_and_effect: lookup owner+start request_key before stale/phase checks (after authentication/owner check); same key+same canonical payload -> persisted same registration (200); same key different payload -> 409; different key on accepted registration -> 409; new registration same unresolved/confirmed effect/ambiguous target blocked. Accept snapshot + key + active state atomically before dispatch; no additional user approval/cancel/resume
routes.response: 202 first durable acceptance; 200 exact replay; job execution errors afterward stored, not HTTP rejection; response lost retry exact key

routes.request_and_effect: GET persisted view only; no external mutation/readback; terminal result mandatory; progress advisory; poll without keeping viewer alive
routes.response: 200 RegistrationView; use revision to ignore stale UI response

routes.request_and_effect: ListQuery cursor/limit; default 20; opaque owner-bound cursor ordered creation then registration_id; no external access

ports.pre: selector allowed length; pure local registry lookup; no arbitrary network
ports.post: supported carries immutable ProfileRef and resolvable value_contract_ref/manifest; unsupported/blocked typed normal; exact identity validated
ports.failure: invalid syntax INVALID_REQUEST; corrupt/missing pinned registry PROFILE_CHANGED/RUNTIME_ERROR; no execution
ports.calls: CO resolves once, PREP/EXEC/RESULT retrieve same pinned content by ref, not re-resolve selector

ports.pre: owner-scoped SourceView, exact pinned Profile, normalized ResolvedAnswer[] for current source/profile, no auth secrets
ports.post: values/facts/provenance/issues; computed ready; source facts/units not overwritten; no external platform mutation
ports.failure: missing/conflict/invalid/model unavailable -> blocking Issue (ready=false); schema/runtime failures typed error; no start

ports.pre: current registration context, pinned profile, owner and auth command; open ready; current rev/generation checks; runtime reads current target intent from CO-owned state
ports.post: verified carries trusted target+ConnectionBinding; open/refresh only human grant; close/failure fence; no job fabricated
ports.failure: prestart no mutation beyond scoped authentication/target read; wrong/unknown account/expired generation/timeout -> unverified or closed; typed Error, no start

ports.pre: durably accepted immutable scope, active state, pinned profile/runtime binding, exclusive worker lease current, mock permission
ports.post: observations and errors linked to persisted evidence; gateway command admission before potential mutation; only actual observations; no direct job state change by adapter
ports.failure: on unexpected error fence via common store, stop future effects; report known/unknown/absence; if runner crashes CO detects orphan and stops, not resume

ports.pre: same pinned profile and AcceptedScope; trusted stored ExecutionReport/EvidenceRecord[]; no browser commands
ports.post: profile goal/proof and scope compared; done only verified goal with no unresolved effects; otherwise stopped outcome, next_action; CO commits result
ports.failure: insufficient/mismatched evidence never success; evaluator error fail closed/unknown unless authoritative absence; terminal record persists

http.auth: owner from authenticated app context; path ids opaque; never accept client owner_ref, approval plan, state, credentials; not found or foreign owner 404
http.content: application/json except H1 described; named $defs validation (not schema root); unknown keys rejected; UTC timestamps; profile validation and relational guards additional; responses redacted
http.note: H4 unsupported/blocked and model issue are normal view when persisted; 503 when cannot complete bounded dependency/transaction. For failures after accepted H7 only persisted job result. All errors carry safe Error message; 409 current_revision when owner allowed. Server unexpected internal errors use 500/RUNTIME_ERROR only when safe response; no stack traces. 401/404/403 common guards apply to all routes.

state.prestart: job_state=null; ready computed; auth separate view; review only ready + verified + target new + policy; approval atomic at start
transition_contract: exact current scope approved & atomically accepted
trusted goal confirmed and required effects resolved
fence new admission; bounded in-flight observation or unknown; persist terminal result
invariants: No user cancellation, modification, resume or rollback after start.
Auth/viewer close button prestart only; viewer dispose alone never stops.
CO changes job lifecycle; STORE transaction enforces state; EXEC records observations and requests error-stop; RESULT pure verdict; never reopen terminal.
Late trustworthy read-only evidence may refine goal verdict with new evidence, not reopen lifecycle; no rebind/resubmit.
At restart, accepted active job without current worker and unobserved admission: fence and stop, preserve uncertainty; do not auto-resume.
state.revision: Every material prestart scope mutation increments registration revision, invalidates prior review. Persist progress/result with monotonic revision; UI ignores older response. Refresh viewer grant fences old grant without silently changing verified binding. Exact key replay precedes stale check. Start key scoped owner+command, canonical request incl path id; no expiration during job/effect retention.

storage.unit: STORE logical single durable authority, not DB schema; CO owner job transitions; gateway may record admission/observation through shared transactional operations; no callbacks while atomic lock

operations.call: accept(owner, registration_id, StartInput, internal Scope) -> RegistrationView or Error
operations.atomic: authenticate owner, lookup key/hash, compare revision/review/scope/profile/connection/permission and semantic target/effect guard; write immutable scope, key, active job together before dispatch; key conflict/duplicate no new job

operations.call: admit(scoped execution context, Operation) -> one-shot dispatch permit or typed Error
operations.atomic: compare active state/current lease+permission+profile+target+binding and registry allowed operation; reserve stable logical effect key before external potential mutation. Reads scoped and cannot execute unknown mutating commands. Exclusive one dispatch; confirmed/pending/unknown duplicate deny. Permit never user-visible.

operations.call: record scoped Observation + trusted EvidenceRecord[] -> durable observation or Error
operations.atomic: match admitted operation/lease/registration/target; preserve proof/unknown; dedupe observation IDs, retain prior effects; actual observation only

operations.call: fence(registration_id, typed Error) -> stopping; finalize(registration_id, Result) -> stopped or done
operations.atomic: serialize fence with S-ADMIT; no later admissions; pending operation not proven absent becomes unknown, bounded in-flight resolution; CO persists result and terminal state; done only confirmed; no terminal reopen

storage.effect_key: (environment, platform, external_account_ref, object_kind, stable slot_ref, stable logical_operation_id). Version/request/worker change cannot bypass existing effect. Mock listing slot uses server source lineage + verified account/platform/object and existing effect check; service configuration target includes category. Distinct actual lesson intent requires distinct legitimate slot and evidence; ambiguous cross-source existing/duplicate => block. Real stable target policy per verified profile. Physical uniqueness/CAS/transaction implementation delegated.

runtime.boundary: EXEC owns auth/runtime facade and platform adapters; RUNTIME gateway is shared internal boundary, not sixth business role or new HTTP API; VIEWER client is runtime-provided UI adapter

calls.signature: withVerifiedConnection(AcceptedScope) -> scoped execution context or Error
calls.rule: runtime lookup exact connection_ref/verified_generation/account, acquire exclusive worker lease; no raw driver or credential to adapter; CO-authorized only

derive stable logical operations from pinned profile, adapter registered operation definitions and accepted values; binding_digest over exact immutable bound values, no ad hoc actions; platform-specific manifest/driver is delegated, registration checks before integration

calls.signature: perform(scoped context, Operation) -> Observation or typed Error
calls.rule: match registry operation identity/step/effect class/binding_digest; actual args from immutable scope/trusted config, never caller free arguments; effect admission durable before browser command; record real observation and evidence; unknown class treated potentially mutating, unexpected action error-stop

calls.signature: observeGoal(scoped context) -> GoalObservation or typed Error
calls.rule: scoped registered read-only operation, actual normalized readback/payload digest and trusted evidence; no copy from input; only profile-required method, after fence no new effects; optional late read observation separate from run; no resume

viewer.input: AuthGrant (current generation + opaque short-lived grant + expiry)
viewer.client_contract: runtime provides mount(container, grant) -> dispose() and ready/error/disconnected events; caller only displays allowed authentication viewer and separately invokes H6 finish/close; dispose is UI detach, not job cancellation. Mount rejects expired/stale/foreign grant. Grant protected by service identity, not logged/URL leaked; no raw driver or credentials in UI API.
viewer.deferred: Actual frontend framework/client adapter package path, transport, endpoints, TTL and timeout numbers chosen 11/27 based on evidence; same-origin or secured allowed origin/owner binding verified.

surfaces: raw text/assets, reuse; owner errors; create immutable version on correction
support, issues/questions, values/source; user answer/correction, reprepare; no start before ready
open/refresh/finish/close prestart; runtime viewer mount; display verified account/target; existing/ambiguous blocked

show exact values/assets/provenance/target/profile goal/steps, notice no user rollback/cancel/change after start; approve once with current revision/digest/key; same request key retained across transport retry
active/stopping/done/stopped, goal verdict/evidence/next_action, reconnect; no cancel/edit/resume; distinguish mock from actual and unknown from failure
ui.presentation: loading, blocked/unsupported, required questions, stale response recovery via H8, owner errors, unknown explicit; no UI inference of success; HTTP response revision monotonic
